date.as_written: nepālikābde karasvādasiṃdhau caitre site (!) sattithi yugme saṃjñake | turaṅgame bhaumavudhasya vāre ... samvat762caitraśuklaḥ || dvitīyā, aśvinīnakṣatra (!) aṃgāvatārathvakunhu

notes: The chronogram 'kara-svāda-siṃdhu' gives 2-6-7 = NS 762, confirmed by 'samvat 762'. The weekday is given both in Sanskrit as bhaumavudhasya vāre (likely an error/mix for bhaumavāra) and in Newari as aṃgāvatāra (aṅgāravāra = Tuesday).
